title: Ketan Agarwal murder: Chetan Chowdhury's family rejects charges as police cite evidence of conspiracy
summary: Chetan Chowdhury's father asserted his son is innocent in the murder of Ketan Agarwal, alleging police miscommunication. Meanwhile, investigation has revealed a planned conspiracy involving Chetan and Siya Goyal, who are currently in custody regarding the case.
